definition: Coh-Metrix is a computational tool that produces indices of the linguistic and discourse representations of a text.
details: Developed by Arthur C. Graesser and Danielle S. McNamara, Coh-Metrix analyzes texts on many different features.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Coh-Metrix — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
